story: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a final polished Instagram STORY poster, portrait 9:16, 1080x1920, for MINI SUMO game. Reference is established game brand and character art; match exactly its cute round topknotted sumo characters, bold dark-brown outlines, warm painted cartoon shading, gold lettering, red-white rope, wood, vermilion shrine and indigo dusk. Recompose specifically for vertical story, not a landscape crop. Generous blank visual breathing space in top 12% and bottom 15% for Instagram controls. Top-middle large spectacular wooden rope badge with exact golden title 'MINI SUMO'. Beneath title exact cream slogan 'PUSH. DASH. WIN.' Middle and lower-middle: four cute wrestlers with red, blue, green and yellow mawashi, red and blue pushing in foreground on a straw-edged dohyo, green and yellow behind, playful high energy dust curls, Japanese shrine, warm lanterns. Lower section within safe area: small cream ribbon reading '2–4 PLAYER PARTY GAME', then a clear green wooden CTA plaque reading 'PLAY NOW'. Keep lowest 15% visually simple and empty so the user can add an Instagram link sticker. Strong hierarchy, large readable English lettering only, no extra text, no watermark, no device mockup. Maintain full characters, correct anatomy, richly polished illustrated game promotion.
videoFrame: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a dedicated first frame for image-to-video animation of MINI SUMO, portrait 9:16 1080x1920. Reference image defines exact brand, round cute sumo wrestlers, bold dark brown outlines, hand painted cartoon shading, golden light, Japanese festival shrine and vermilion/indigo palette. This is an animation-ready cinematic scene, NOT a poster. Two main cute round topknotted sumo wrestlers in full body on a straw-edged circular dohyo, red mawashi on left and blue on right, facing each other with hands raised and a clear small gap between their hands and bodies, feet grounded, ready to push. Clean readable anatomy and separated limbs, expressive competitive smiling faces. Medium-wide low three-quarter camera, wrestlers in middle-lower frame, complete ring rim visible with breathing room. Small green and yellow wrestlers stand far behind at the edge watching, distinct separated silhouettes. Glowing Japanese shrine background, hanging paper lanterns, banners, distant cheering audience simplified, warm twilight. Sparse dust near feet, a few floating cherry petals. Upper quarter shows uncluttered indigo sunset sky to allow an editor to overlay title later. Stable spatial layout and parallax depth, foreground ring then characters then distant shrine. Absolutely no text, logo, title, CTA, user interface, watermark, motion blur, collage or split screen. High quality matching illustrated game key art. Maintain the same 2D illustration appearance throughout.
